item.title: Grey County's homeless count remains stable in 2025, bucks trend
item.description: By 2035, Ontario homelessness is projected to total 177,000 people, up from nearly 85,000 people at the end of 2025. But if there’s an economic downturn, homelessness could reach almost 300,000.
